rea: REA/Ghidra successfully analyzed the original observed SSE2 initializer with one runtime-derived function seed. Recovered operation: DAT_0113d308 = (float)DAT_010ebb20. Caller coverage is incomplete; this is not original source or a CPU compatibility fix. REA/Ghidra also analyzed original function 0x00c096d0: two TryEnterCriticalSection calls with TLS-dependent contention behavior, paired LeaveCriticalSection. See REA-AS3-LOCK.md.
